note: Frozen bytes of the write-ahead log entry format with an origin block (docs/specs/bucket-replication-spec.md 20.3, replication-stream-build.md step 1.1). Each entry is the full plain-log entry for op 0, bucket q, key k, data d. Changing a byte here is a change to an on-disk format that a node has already written; do not without the owner's decision. The replica vector was changed once, by the owner's decision of 2026-10-16 (BUG-0581): its block became kind 3 and carries the owner's outcome and the term. The kind 2 vector is the earlier build's replica entry, frozen at ec69cbdf: by the owner's decision of 2026-10-16 it is still read (outcome unknown, no term) and never written, so it is decode_only. Segment format 2 (owner decision D-1 of docs/specs/wal-preallocated-segments-spec.md, 2026-10-26) is the decision that changed the written bytes: every new segment has a 24-byte header and each entry's CRC also covers the segment's generation, so the four format 1 vectors became decode_only (a node still reads them) and each has a segment format 2 twin, a whole segment (header, then the entry) with the generation fixed at 0123456789abcdef through the test seam. The last two rows are the retained log of the entry ring (docs/specs/entry-ring-conventions.md section 9): the key is the 26-byte position 42:55401 of slot 17, database 3, and the data is the worked 94-byte record of record format 2 (docs/specs/entry-ring-storage-format.md section 1.2: the 18-byte header with the request id at offset 1 and the op index at 17, then the 76-byte body whose first bytes are the class and the flags), logged as an Own and a Replica entry with an empty bucket label (a ring entry carries none; the key and the body name the bucket).
